# A Haswell-generation Intel GPU as the i965 driver reports it.
#
# NOT captured on a Haswell machine -- reconstructed from the i965 driver's
# profile list, because the box this was written on has Iris Xe (see
# vainfo-iris-xe.txt, which IS a real capture). The shape that matters here is
# the one it shares with every pre-Skylake Intel GPU: H.264 in hardware, no VP9,
# no AV1 -- and, like the real capture, H.264 advertised for ENCODING as well,
# which must not be mistaken for decoding.
